name: Ayşe
presentingProblem: I've been feeling really low for a few months. I can't seem to enjoy anything anymore and I'm struggling to get out of bed.
backstory: Ayşe works as a graphic designer in Istanbul. She grew up with a critical mother who set high standards and rarely praised her. She recently went through a breakup after a 3-year relationship. She has a small circle of close friends but has been withdrawing from them lately. She used to love painting and hiking but has abandoned both.

coreBeliefs: I don't deserve to be happy
If I try and fail, it confirms I'm worthless
intermediateBeliefs: I should achieve something significant to feel worthy
Asking for help means I'm weak
If I'm not productive, I have no value
automaticThoughts: What's the point of getting up?
I'm such a burden to everyone
triggers: Being asked about hobbies she's abandoned
